text:
### Customer Education  
**Customer Awareness:**
- Security tips in welcome pack
- Phishing email examples in communications
- "Never give password to anyone" messages
- Advice: "If bank calls, call bank back using known number"  
**Reporting Encouragement:**
- Clear fraud reporting channel (0800-555-2265)
- Online fraud form available
- Branch staff trained on fraud questions
- Rapid response to fraud reports
name: Chunk 16/32

raw_entities.name: Customer Education and Fraud Awareness Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy establishing customer education and awareness requirements to mitigate fraud risk through security guidance, phishing awareness, and clear fraud reporting channels. The policy mandates provision of security tips, phishing examples, password protection advice, and encourages rapid customer reporting of suspected fraud.
context: Never give password to anyone messages

raw_entities.name: Security Tips Provision in Welcome Pack
raw_entities.description: Requirement to include security tips in customer welcome pack materials upon account opening or product issuance.

raw_entities.name: Phishing Email Examples in Customer Communications
raw_entities.description: Requirement to include phishing email examples in regular customer communications to educate customers on fraud recognition and prevention.

raw_entities.name: Password Protection Messaging
raw_entities.description: Requirement to communicate to customers that they must never share their password with anyone, including bank staff.
context: Never give password to anyone messages

raw_entities.name: Callback Verification Advice
raw_entities.description: Requirement to advise customers that if the bank calls them, they should hang up and call the bank back using a known, verified number to prevent social engineering fraud.
context: Advice: If bank calls, call bank back using known number

raw_entities.name: Fraud Reporting Channel Availability
raw_entities.description: Requirement to maintain and publicise a clear fraud reporting channel accessible to customers, including telephone and online reporting options.

raw_entities.name: Branch Staff Training on Fraud Reporting
raw_entities.description: Requirement to train branch staff to handle customer fraud inquiries and reports competently.
context: Branch staff trained on fraud questions

raw_entities.name: Rapid Response to Fraud Reports
raw_entities.description: Requirement to respond promptly to customer fraud reports to minimise loss and demonstrate commitment to fraud prevention.

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: The risk of fraudulent activity targeting customer accounts, including phishing, social engineering, password compromise, and unauthorised transactions. This policy addresses fraud prevention through customer education and rapid reporting mechanisms.
context: Never give password to anyone messages

raw_entities.name: Fraud Reporting Channel
raw_entities.description: Operational control providing customers with a dedicated telephone line (0800-555-2265) and online form to report suspected fraud incidents. Enables rapid detection and response to fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Customer Security Awareness Materials
raw_entities.description: Educational materials and communications provided to customers including security tips in welcome packs, phishing email examples, and password protection guidance to build customer resilience against fraud.
context: Never give password to anyone messages

raw_entities.name: Branch Staff
raw_entities.description: Branch staff responsible for handling customer fraud inquiries and reports. Must be trained to respond competently to fraud-related questions and facilitate customer reporting.
context: Branch staff trained on fraud questions

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer receiving security education, fraud awareness communications, and access to fraud reporting channels. Customers are expected to protect their passwords and verify bank contact through known numbers.
context: Never give password to anyone messages
If bank calls, call bank back using known number

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection and Reporting
raw_entities.description: Operational obligation to detect, investigate, and respond rapidly to customer fraud reports submitted through dedicated reporting channels. Supports customer protection and loss minimisation.
